head: working-tree
subject: Controller-owned LRS runner
change: runtime.Controller accepts an optional Options.lrs { sender, control_plane, client, reporter, poll_interval, connect_timeout }. After the first successful SotW or delta start/synchronization it creates and starts one lrs.Runner against the destination channel, bounding the initial LRS connect budget by the caller's remaining deadline. Later starts/synchronizations are no-ops and Controller.deinit stops and joins the runner before releasing the destination. The LRS control plane must be dedicated to the runner, and the destination channel must enable LRS statistics.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/runtime/lrs_tests.zig starts a real loopback LRS server and bootstrap control plane, creates a controller with Options.lrs, runs both startWithDeadline and startDeltaWithDeadline, observes the initial node request, asserts no terminal runner failure, and verifies Controller.deinit shuts the runner down.

notes: The runner is auxiliary to discovery: a failed initial LRS connect currently fails the start call. Applications that need reporting outages to be non-fatal should construct lrs.Runner themselves. Authority-specific control planes, SDS/certificate providers and non-router filters remain open.
